sermons.title: Sermon 78 | The Character of Christ's People

scripture.verse: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

sermons.title: Sermon 79 | The Form of Sound Words

scripture.verse: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

sermons.title: Sermon 80 | God Alone the Salvation of his People

scripture.verse: He only is my rock and my salvation.

sermons.title: Sermon 81 & 82 | The God of the Aged

scripture.verse: Even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you. I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
Then Job answered the Lord and said, Behold, I am vile.
Where he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.
The voice of the Lord is full of majesty.
